source.title: [Bounty] [BOUNTY][$420][ADD] P. Diddy Lube
source.body:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/theselfish/SlopStation13/issues/40

### 漏洞描述 / Description
[BOUNTY][$420][ADD] P. Diddy Lube


### Bounty Details:
Add P. Diddy lube to SlopStation13. Must be compatible with the Kirkinator item & provide buffs to it as well as have full sprites and sound effects for the item and aforementioned interactions between the Kirkinator and P. Diddy lube


### Bounty Reward:
420 Vietnamese Dong will be paid out via ZaloPay upon completion of this bounty, however you must be present at the Finnish Embassy in Canberra (Australia) to receive it due to geological spacetime continuum difficulties between Karl Marx and Che Guevara which has disrupted ZaloPay's ecological network system. 

### Requirements for bounty payout:
1. Your pull request must pass all Continuous Integration checks.
2. Your pull request must include all required spritework in the proper relevant .dmi files.
3. I might not feel like paying you at all, please contact me via WeChat to negotiate if you want to be paid.
4.  All conversations regarding the bounty should occur either on this issue, or on the pull request you open yourself.
5. You must speak in mandarin while conversing about anything regarding the bounty.
6. You must receive permission from Sean Combs to add this to the repository. 


### 积分币奖励 / Coin Reward
525 coins

### 真实赏金（USD）/ Real Reward
$420

### 难度 / Difficulty
Medium

### 认领方式
评论 `/claim` 锁定任务 24h

### 兑换说明
> 查看 [REWARD_POLICY.md](REWARD_POLICY.md) 了解兑换规则

comments.author: Luando-tester
comments.text:
Hi, I'm PepperResearch, an independent researcher and Python automation developer (GitHub: Luando-tester). I'd like to take on this task.

Here is my implementation plan:
1. Review the SlopStation13 codebase requirements for adding the "P. Diddy lube" item and its integration with the Kirkinator.
2. Implement the item logic, buffs, and interaction mechanics using Python/code structures relevant to the project, alongside the necessary `.dmi` spritework and sound effect integration.
3. Verify compatibility, test interactions between the Kirkinator and the lube, and ensure all CI checks pass.
4. Prepare the pull request and document all changes clearly on the issue/PR.

ETA: 3 days.

Please assign this issue to me or confirm so I can begin.
